title: Grand Dark Waltz Allegro
instruments: Piano, Cellos, Violas, Flute, Celesta, Trumpet, French Horn, Drum Kit
description: Whilst learning to waltz, I noticed that the music wasn't flowing exactly with the explanations of how to move - so I fixed it. This piece overemphasizes the first beat with a hard slide in on the downbeat. Should make it easier for beginners to understand what is going on. The are 3 tempos to practice different styles of waltz, or just work up to the fast one!

title: Concentration
description: Imagine yourself floating in a beautiful sky, the aggressive badgers of the land do not bother you here at all. Todd from HR doesn't try to make small talk with you in this place, nor does he try to invite you to his kid's wrestling tournament that is being held at a school 90 minutes away. The coyote-lizards of your night terrors do not roam here, and you can clearly read the expiration dates on all your packages. Even the hand soap. Why does the hand soap have an expiration date? It matters not.

title: Night of Chaos
description: The mellow guitar lulls you on a superficial level, while being undermined by the synths.

title: Evening of Chaos
instruments: Piano, Percussion, Synths, Strings, Brass, Glockenspiel
description: Semi-beautiful and flawed piano melody contrasts with industrial percussion.

title: Ghost Story
description: Spooky piece, slow moving in 2 parts written for 4 percussionists. Second movement starts at 2:30.

title: Dark Fog
description: The title refers to a state of mind more than a physical thing. That sort of feeling you get when there are choices to be made... none of them very good ones.

title: Moonlight Hall
instruments: Celesta, Tuba, Choir, Oboe, Bassoon, Violins, Violas, Cellos, Basses, Flute, Piccolo, Timpani, Percussion
description: 6/8 Starts nice, Ends frantic. The original melody was written to be performed on a Viol de Gamba... but I moved it over to oboe.

title: Virtutes Instrumenti
description: Based on 11th century sacred music, this piece can set you way way back in time almost instantly. Several faster and slower sections are available during this piece.

title: Lightless Dawn
description: Add a dark intensity to any scene... Is there building action? Is there a clue? Is there a need for ambiguity?
feel: Dark, Eerie, Mysterious, Mystical, Somber, Unnerving

title: Long note One
description: Just a very long pad for use under dialog.

title: Air Prelude
description: Slow; lots of flutes; some digital synth for texture.

title: Comfortable Mystery
description: Solo vintage electric piano. Not quite supernatural... more like surreal. Slow with descending arpeggios.

title: Distant Tension
description: Background horror music. Symphonic with some digital processing. Some tremolo basses in the beginning are meant to be removed and integrated on their own.
